license_required.quote: After July 1, 2018, an individual may not engage in the practice of midwifery unless: (1) the individual is issued a certificate by a board under IC 25-1-5 and is acting within the scope of the person's license; or (2) the individual has a certified direct entry midwife certificate under this article and has a collaborative agreement with a physician as set forth in this article.

interval_years.quote: Subject to IC 25-1-2-6 (e), a certificate issued under this chapter expires after two (2) years, on a date established by the licensing agency.

required.quote: Establish annual continuing education requirements to renew a certified direct entry midwife's certificate, which must include continuing education in pharmacology. The requirements established under this subdivision must provide for at least fifteen (15) hours of continuing education every twelve (12) months.

available.quote: The board may issue a certificate to an individual who is licensed or certified as a midwife in another state if: (1) the board determines that the midwife has fulfilled requirements that are at least equal to the certification requirements of this article

requirements.value: The out-of-state midwife must have fulfilled requirements at least equal to Indiana's; hold a license or certificate in good standing from another state; have practiced at least 3 of the past 5 years under that license; disclose any malpractice judgment or settlement; and have no conviction in the past 5 years bearing directly on competent practice.
requirements.quote: the board determines that the midwife has fulfilled requirements that are at least equal to the certification requirements of this article; (2) the midwife holds a license or certificate in good standing from another state and the midwife has practiced for at least three (3) out of the past five (5) years under the license or certificate; (3) the midwife discloses to the board any judgment or settlement of malpractice and the board makes a determination that the judgment or settlement does not affect the midwife's ability to practice as a midwife; and (4) the midwife does not have a conviction in the previous five (5) years that has a direct bearing on the midwife's ability to practice competently.

authority.quote: The midwifery committee is established to provide recommendations and information to the board.

national_certification.quote: Establish as a requirement for certification as a certified direct entry midwife the Certified Professional Midwife credentials developed by the North American Registry of Midwives or a successor organization.

national_association.quote: Develop a peer review procedure, using as guidelines the peer review procedures established by: (A) the Indiana Midwives Association or a successor organization; and (B) the North American Registry of Midwives or a successor organization.

regulatory_model.quote: After July 1, 2018, an individual who knowingly or intentionally practices midwifery without a certificate required under this article commits a Level 6 felony

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice certified direct entry midwifery to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of sections 1 and 2 of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: After July 1, 2018, an individual may not engage in the practice of midwifery unless: (1) the individual is issued a certificate by a board under IC 25-1-5 and is acting within the scope of the person's license; or (2) the individual has a certified direct entry midwife certificate under this article

title_protection.quote: After July 1, 2014, only an individual who is issued a certificate under this article may use the title "certified direct entry midwife".

scope_protection.quote: After July 1, 2018, an individual who knowingly or intentionally practices midwifery without a certificate required under this article commits a Level 6 felony

definition_quote.value: "Practice of midwifery" means services delivered by a certified direct entry midwife, including, for compensation, to advise, attend, or assist a woman during pregnancy, labor, natural childbirth, or the postpartum period.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of midwifery" means services delivered by a certified direct entry midwife, including, for compensation, to advise, attend, or assist a woman during pregnancy, labor, natural childbirth, or the postpartum period.

value: Providing the mother with individualized prenatal care
Identifying and referring women who require obstetrical attention
Providing the mother with continuous direct participation and assistance during labor and delivery
Administering medications as provided in IC 25-23.4-4-5
Providing the mother with postpartum support
Providing normal newborn care
methods_authorized.quote: The term includes the following: (1) Providing the mother with individualized prenatal care. (2) Identifying and referring women who require obstetrical attention. (3) Providing the mother with continuous direct participation and assistance during labor and delivery. (4) Administering medications as provided in IC 25-23.4-4-5. (5) Providing the mother with postpartum support. (6) Providing normal newborn care.

drug_authority.value: A certified direct entry midwife may carry and administer postpartum antihemorrhagic drugs (emergency), local anesthetics by infiltration or topical application for postpartum repair, oxygen, and prophylactic antibiotics for Group B Strep, under a physician protocol. May also administer Vitamin K (oral or IM), Rhogam, and prophylactic ophthalmic antibiotics with a physician's order. May not administer drugs intravenously. No prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: A certified direct entry midwife may carry and administer the following medications under a protocol issued and agreed to by a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5 : (1) Postpartum antihemorrhagic drugs in emergency situations. (2) Local anesthetics by infiltration or topical application, only for postpartum repair of lacerations, tears, and episiotomy. (3) Oxygen. (4) Prophylactic antibiotics for Group B Strep (also known as Beta Strep).

national_credential_required.quote: Provide proof to the board that the applicant has obtained the Certified Professional Midwife credential as administered by the North American Registry of Midwives or a successor organization.

meac_accredited_program_required.quote: Satisfactorily complete educational curriculum approved by: (A) the Midwifery Education Accreditation Council (MEAC) or a successor organization; or (B) the educational equivalent of a Midwifery Education Accreditation Council curriculum approved by the board.

cpr_certification_required.quote: Obtain certification by an accredited association in adult cardiopulmonary resuscitation that is approved by the board.

neonatal_resuscitation_certification_req.quote: Complete the program sponsored by the American Academy of Pediatrics in neonatal resuscitation, excluding endotracheal intubation and the administration of drugs.

clinical_birth_experience_requirements.value: Comply with the birth requirements of the CPM credentialing process, observe an additional 20 births, attend 20 births conducted by a physician, assist with an additional 20 births, and act as the primary attendant for an additional 20 births.
clinical_birth_experience_requirements.quote: Comply with the birth requirements of the Certified Professional Midwife credentialing process, observe an additional twenty (20) births, attend twenty (20) births conducted by a physician, assist with an additional twenty (20) births, and act as the primary attendant for an additional twenty (20) births.

collaborative_agreement_required.quote: A certified direct entry midwife must have a collaborating agreement with a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5 .

collaborative_agreement_details.value: The collaborating physician must register intent to collaborate with the board annually, file the written agreement signed by both parties, and submit a statement of intent to comply. The physician must examine the client at least once in the first trimester and once in the third trimester. Collaboration does not require physical presence of the physician. A certified direct entry midwife must notify the board of changes to collaborating physicians within 30 days.
collaborative_agreement_details.quote: Register with the board the physician's intent to collaborate with a certified direct entry midwife. The registration must include the following: (A) The name, the business address, and the telephone number of the collaborating physician. (B) The name, the business address, and the telephone number of the certified direct entry midwife. (C) Any other information required by the board. The registration must be updated annually.

independent_practice_permitted.quote: the individual has a certified direct entry midwife certificate under this article and has a collaborative agreement with a physician as set forth in this article.

prescription_authority_prohibited.quote: The board may not adopt rules to grant a certified direct entry midwife prescriptive authority other than the authority specified in IC 25-23.4-4-5 .

controlled_substance_restrictions.value: A certified direct entry midwife may not administer a drug intravenously and may not dispense or administer prescription drugs except as specifically enumerated.
controlled_substance_restrictions.quote: Except as provided in subsection (b), a certified direct entry midwife may not dispense or administer prescription drugs.

consultation_referral_trigger_conditions.quote: a certified direct entry midwife shall refer a client to a physician in the client's first and third trimester of pregnancy. (c) If a client has a health condition that makes the client at risk, the certified direct entry midwife shall, subject to rules adopted under IC 25-23.4-2-6 (b): (1) refer the client to a licensed physician; and (2) consult with the physician concerning the client's care.

emergency_transfer_plan_required.quote: The certified direct entry midwife must have an emergency plan for the care of the client if an emergency arises.

hospital_transfer_protocol_requirements.value: The client must sign a release of medical records allowing the certified direct entry midwife to provide medical records to a physician if an emergency arises. The certified direct entry midwife must maintain and transfer medical records to a treating physician if an emergency arises.

newborn_screening_obligations.quote: After a client has given birth, the certified direct entry midwife shall: (1) provide the client with a statement indicating that the newborn infant should be examined by a pediatrician or family practice physician for checkups beginning within two (2) weeks after birth; and (2) identify with the client a pediatrician or family practice physician for the care of the infant.
